module.name: Scribe
module.description: Scribe is a new commercial module in FreePBX/PBXact that enhances your communication capabilities through advanced transcription services. This module seamlessly integrates with Freepbx/PBXact voicemail and call recordings modules to transcribe the audio files. This module also generates the Artificial intelligence driven sentiment analysis applied to recorded calls.
